name: ROSA3D (ROSA PLAST Sp. z o.o.)
summary: Polish filament manufacturer in Hipolitow near Warsaw, self-described as a 'Polish manufacturer of 3D printing filament'. Broad catalogue spanning PLA, PET-G (including a high-speed grade), PCTG, ABS, ASA, PC, TPU, PA (incl. PA12+CF), PP/PP-GF30, HIPS and an R-Series recycled range, with specialty ESD-safe, medical-grade and PTFE-infused grades.

product_lines.name: PET-G
product_lines.notes: Standard and Standard HS (high speed); a PTFE-infused PET-G is also offered

product_lines.name: BIO / BioWOOD
product_lines.notes: Wood-filled bio line; base polymer assumed PLA, not explicitly confirmed

product_lines.name: R-Series (recycled)
product_lines.notes: R-PLA, R-PET-G and R-PET-G Impact made from recycled feedstock

additional_notes: Registered address: ROSA PLAST Sp. z o.o., ul. Hipolitowska 102B, 05-074 Hipolitow, Poland; production at the same site. Named a Forbes Diamonds 2026 winner (Polish business-growth recognition) and pushes a strong education/classroom positioning ('Filaments for a Great Start - 3D Printing in Education'). No dedicated build-plate or print-surface products found. Carried by pan-European retailer 3DJake alongside other Polish brands, corroborating an established distribution footprint.

provenance.conflicts: In-house extrusion is implied by the company's self-description and a TikTok promo referencing 'the factory that makes your favorite filament', but no primary facility documentation was fetched; the factory-reference source is a third-party account and is itself unverified. No OEM counterparty could be named, so oem_relationships is omitted. Exact $/kg unconfirmed.
